parent_behavior_scope: published 10+20-minute serial preparation on the B01 normal path
business_delta: Retain every B02 row and add two SPECIAL personnel types, station allocation and a two-P-CREW demand on INSPECT (SEQ 1). SERVICE (SEQ 2) remains unresourced.

capacity-2.expected: Two P-CREW are acquired for INSPECT at 07:00, released at 07:10, SERVICE completes at 07:30, and the mission launches 08:00 and completes 10:00. Personnel lease integrates to 20 person-minutes.

capacity-1.expected: INSPECT requests two P-CREW and waits; one unit is insufficient. No partial booking, work, SERVICE start or mission launch. Record the native cancellation time and stopped state from raw evidence.

capacity-0.expected: INSPECT requests two P-CREW and waits; no crew is available. No booking, work, SERVICE start or mission launch. Record the native cancellation time and stopped state from raw evidence.

wrong-specialty.expected: Two P-OTHER cannot satisfy the two-P-CREW request. No booking, work, SERVICE start or mission launch. Record the native cancellation time and stopped state from raw evidence.

assertions.C01-102-A1: All four variants retain B02 business identity, schedule and serial breakdown exactly; their only sibling difference is ResourceAllocation.RQTY.
assertions.C01-102-A2: The native request for INSPECT is P-CREW quantity two; any P-OTHER capacity is disjoint and no alternative resource is declared.
assertions.C01-102-A3: Capacity two acquires both units before work, releases both after INSPECT, preserves SERVICE ordering, and yields one successful mission.
assertions.C01-102-A4: Capacity one, zero and wrong specialty never book partial capacity or start any preparation work or mission.
assertions.C01-102-A5: For blocked variants, cancellation and stopped state are read from native evidence; no deadline time is inferred from the input alone.
